messages:
elaine_p: Quick follow-up from the eviction postmortem: we need concrete test deliverables so this doesn't regress. Proposing: reproducible unit/regression tests, an eval promptset, a short load spike, and a chaos drill. Who takes what?

todd_r: I'll take the reproducible tests. Plan: `tests/eviction_cases` with deterministic sequences that exercised the bug. PR with cases + CI hooks by 04/20.

samir: I'll build the eval promptset (EVAL-420) — include streaming truncation cases and repeat-token loops. Will add expected outputs and fuzzy-match thresholds. PR by 04/18, run by 04/21.

dina_oncall: I'll schedule a targeted k6 spike and a chaos job that reboots one worker mid-spike. Suggest staging drill 04/22 09:00 PT. I'll publish runbook in #eng-oncall.

qa-jen: I'll gate merges on the new tests; add a `cache-evict` CI job. Need Todd's test names and Samir's golden outputs before CI rule creation.

incident-bot: created TASK-PLAT-950 assigned to todd_r: "Eviction reproducible tests + CI".

elaine_p: Owner recap for PM-FOLLOWUP-5011: todd -> tests (TASK-PLAT-950), samir -> eval promptset (EVAL-420), dina -> load & chaos (TASK-OPS-615), qa-jen -> gating. Please post PR links to the ticket.

samir: noted — will include token/sequence scoring and a small hallucination metric.

todd_r: adding a small deploy smoke `curl` that hits a warm key to validate cache warming. Will include in PR.

qa-jen: confirming ETAs. I'll open the CI gating PR after Todd's tests land.

dina_oncall: I'll run the staging drill and report results in PM-FOLLOWUP-5011.

elaine_p: thanks everyone. I'll track weekly until closed. :thumbsup:
